verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an agent development platform, but the evidence shows no deployment of Factory's core platform on user infrastructure. Bring Your Own Machine only registers a user-managed machine as a Droid Computer execution environment, and the SDK and CLI run the agent harness locally. These are adjacent capabilities, not a self-hosted core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Bring Your Own Machine (BYOM) lets you register your own Linux, macOS, or Windows machine as a Droid Computer.
